title: Carlos is an awesome guide!   Fun, intellectual and witty!
text: Carlos was a great guide.  Provided unbelievable details mixed in with humor and wit!  He took some awesome family photos for us that we’ll cherish forever.  So glad we booked this.  We definitely learned much more than had we just toured it ourselves and taken the audio tour.   Highly recommend you book Carlos!
author: Steven_F

title: A must-do whenever you visit the beautiful city of Sevilla!
text:
Carlos isn’t just incredibly knowledgeable—he’s also wonderfully witty, making the entire experience both informative and fun. What truly made it special was sharing it during our sibling reunion; coming from the Philippines, Canada, the USA, and Madrid.
It became one of the highlights of our trip and a memory we will always treasure. Thank you, Carlos, for making our time in Sevilla so memorable!
author: PVGordon

title: Professional guide with passion of Seville history.
text: Carlos is professional and knowledgeable,  I love the way how he turns all hard facts in an easy understanding manners, our group enjoyed his tour very much.
author: Rosina S

title: Great Tour!
text: We had a great time with Carlos. The tour was perfect. He was engaging and informative. Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone visiting Seville.
author: Ben_I

title: Tour of Seville cathedral during very busy time
text: Carlos was great.  Enough information without overwhelming us. A wonderful experience  we didn’t appreciate how busy it would be the week after Easter. His quick access and focus on key elements was well worth it

title: Carlos is the best Tour guide in town
text: We did not plan to join the tour of Alcazar but glad surely that we did! If you are planning to visit Alcazar I highly suggest to use tour guide to enjoy more of the visit, understand every story behind the building, the painting, the architecture, everything. And Carlos is definitely the guide you need. author: MirsAmst

title: Marnie
text: Carlos was excellent!  He is an incredibly knowledgeable guide. We were in line without tickets and prepared to wait an hour.  Carlos, in a completely non-pressuring manner, explained what he could offer us:  15 euros each (for seniors), which included tickets for the tour (he handled our passports as proof of our age for discount tickets), and ear phones so we could hear every word of the tour. We were in a small group. The experience was a highlight of our visit to Seville.
author: MarnieM77

title: Best tour so far of our trip to Spain
text: Take this 1 1/2 hour tour! It was very reasonably priced, fun, and Carlos was our best guide so far. We'd take any tour with him. His English is excellent and his accent easy to understand. His knowledge of the Alcázar and Spanish history is terrific, and he is an all-round nice guy who made this a very memorable trip for us. Thank you, Carlos.
author: JanOnTheGo
